title: Numbered Masks, 2022 to 2024
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 23 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: The masks of 2023 and 2024. After the named series ended, nnxyz kept drawing heads, and these twenty-three are the numbered ones: packed faces with teeth, crowns and crossed eyes, drawn between July 2023 and May 2024. They are denser than the earlier masks, and the line is heavier.

Most of them have a beam. A bar of yellow or red crosses the face at eye height, or shoots from one eye to the edge. Under it the face is built the old way, from boxes and rings and a grille of teeth, but the scribble over it is now thick enough to be a surface of its own.
Watch the ground. In the first masks it is white or grey. By December 2023 it is green, purple and gold, and the last masks of spring 2024 stand on red, blue and orange.

chapters.title: Summer 2023
chapters.opening: July and August 2023. Four heads to begin: a dark head in glasses on white, two crowned masks, a round scribbled head, and a skull on stripes.

works.title: nnxyz #1
works.text: A dark head in round glasses on white, its skull a weave of colored scribble, a grin of white teeth across the whole jaw, and a yellow beam crossing behind the glasses. The glasses are two yellow lenses in dark rings. The teeth are drawn large, each one outlined, in a row that runs past the edges of the face. It is the first numbered mask, from July 18, 2023, with 423 recorded strokes.
works.caption: A dark head in round yellow glasses on white, a grin across the whole jaw, a beam behind.
works.reading: The skull is drawn in loops of pink, green, blue and white over black. The beam is a soft yellow band at eye height. Below the teeth the chin is a dark mass of scribble, and the shoulders are black with a few colored strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #2
works.text: Two masks side by side in red, black and yellow scribble, the left one crowned, with a red X over one eye and a grin of white teeth, the right one smaller with a box of teeth.
works.caption: Two masks side by side in red, black and yellow scribble, the left one crowned with a red X eye.
works.reading: The crown is a yellow zigzag at the top of the left head. The X eye is red over a yellow ring. The teeth are two rows of white blocks. The right mask has a red box for a mouth and a white box eye. Recorded with 260 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #3
works.text: A round head in dense yellow, green and blue scribble on grey, with a ringed eye at the left, a box eye at the right, and a mouth of white teeth in a red box, a yellow bar across the top.
works.caption: A round head in dense yellow, green and blue scribble on grey, ringed eye, box eye, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The head is outlined in a thick yellow loop. The ringed eye is black and white spirals. The box eye at the right holds a small ring. The teeth are white blocks in a red box at the lower center. Recorded with 269 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #4
works.text: A skull mask on red and pink stripes, drawn in blue, orange and white line, with a target eye, a grille of white teeth and a red heart at the lower right.
works.caption: A skull mask on red and pink stripes in blue line, a target eye, white teeth, a red heart.
works.reading: The stripes run horizontally behind the skull in red, pink and orange. The target eye is gold rings with a dark center. The teeth are white blocks in a dark box. The heart is red with a dark edge. Recorded with 247 strokes.

chapters.title: November Masks
chapters.opening: November 2023. A patterned boxy mask with hearts, a brown one with red crosses, a white-outlined head with its tongue out, and a dark mask lit by a beam.

works.title: nnxyz #5
works.text: A boxy mask on grey, packed with pattern: a red X eye, a box eye, a grille of teeth, two red hearts at the lower center, a cup at the left, and a second small face at the upper left with its own grin. Blue, red and yellow line runs over the whole in loops and ladders. It is the busiest mask in the room, drawn November 2, 2023, with 225 strokes.
works.caption: A boxy mask on grey packed with pattern, a red X eye, a grille of teeth, two red hearts.
works.reading: The small face at the upper left has a crown and a row of teeth. The cup at the left is drawn in red line. The hearts are red with white edges. A long red tongue hangs from the main mouth. Blue ladders run down the left side.

works.title: nnxyz #6
works.text: A brown boxy mask with two red crosses in its eyes and a mouth of white and black bars, drawn in black and blue line on brown, with a pink flower at the top.
works.caption: A brown boxy mask with red crosses in both eyes and a grille of white and black bars.
works.reading: The crosses are red X marks in dark boxes. The mouth is a grille of white bars with black between. The flower is pink loops on a thin stem. Blue and black ladders run around the mask. Recorded with 125 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #7
works.text: A head outlined in thick white on black, its face a mass of colored scribble, with two red star eyes, a red mouth open on white teeth and a long red tongue hanging out. The outline is one heavy white loop around the whole head and shoulders. The tongue is the brightest thing in the picture. It is the one mask in the room with its mouth open wide.
works.caption: A head outlined in thick white on black, red star eyes, mouth open, a long tongue out.
works.reading: The stars are two red X marks with points, in rings. The scribble inside the face is pink, blue, green and yellow. The tongue is a red curve with a dark line down its middle. Purple strokes fill the right of the ground. Recorded with 294 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #9
works.text: A dark mask on yellow and olive, with a yellow crossed eye at the right, a beam of orange shooting from it, a grid of lines over everything and a red mouth of white bars.
works.caption: A dark mask on yellow, a crossed eye with an orange beam shooting from it, white bars below.
works.reading: The beam is an orange bar from the eye to the right edge. The mask is dark grey with blue and white scribble. The grid is fine white lines across the whole square. Black dots run down the left side. Recorded with 197 strokes.

chapters.title: Two Days in December
chapters.opening: December 28 to 30, 2023. Eight masks in three days: rays, a crown, a flower eye, a pink hand, a yellow cap, small skulls, red hands, and a head in beams.

works.title: nnxyz #10
works.text: A mask in a field of yellow and orange rays, with two ringed eyes, a grin of white teeth in a red mouth, and purple strokes like lashes.
works.caption: A mask in a field of yellow and orange rays, two ringed eyes, white teeth in a red mouth.
works.reading: The rays come in from the upper corners in thick yellow strokes. The eyes are rings with dark centers, the left one larger. The mouth is a red box with white teeth. Recorded with 145 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #11
works.text: A mask on purple outlined in thick white with a scalloped edge, a crown of white spikes, a box eye, a bar across the brow, and a grille of white teeth in red.
works.caption: A mask on purple outlined in thick scalloped white, a crown of spikes, white teeth in red.
works.reading: The outline is one white loop with scallops like a cloud. The crown is white zigzag. The eye is a box with a small ring. The teeth are a long grille of white bars in a red mouth. Eighty-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #13
works.text: A dark mask on green with a crest of black spikes, a blue flower for one eye and a box with a ring for the other, a red beam from the left, and a grin of white teeth. Rows of red hearts run down the right edge. The flower eye is drawn with pointed blue petals around a yellow center. It is the first of eight masks drawn in three days at the end of December 2023.
works.caption: A dark mask on green with a crest of black spikes, a blue flower eye, a red beam.
works.reading: The spikes are thick black strokes along the top. The beam is a red and yellow bar from the left edge to the flower eye. The teeth are white blocks in a black mouth. The hearts at the right are small and red. Recorded with 369 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #15
works.text: A dark mask on purple with a pink hand pressed to the top of its head, two ringed eyes, and a grin of white teeth in a red mouth, yellow line around.
works.caption: A dark mask on purple with a pink hand pressed to its head, grinning with white teeth.
works.reading: The hand is drawn in pink and red with the fingers spread over the crown. The eyes are rings, one with a yellow center. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth. Yellow and white line loops around the head. Recorded with 176 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #20
works.text: A head in a yellow cap on grey, its face a cage of white and red line with two ringed eyes and a grin of white teeth, in seventy-two strokes.
works.caption: A head in a yellow cap on grey, its face a cage of white and red line, grinning.
works.reading: The cap is yellow with a green brim and the artist's mark on the crown. The face is drawn in white loops over black with red inside. The teeth are a row of white blocks in a red mouth. A red shirt is drawn in loops below.

works.title: nnxyz #25
works.text: A grey skull mask with a pink hand and a crossed eye at the left, a box of teeth in red, and five small white skulls floating at the right, each with its own face. A red beam crosses from the left. The small skulls are drawn in black line on white, like a crowd of ghosts watching. It is the one mask with company.
works.caption: A grey skull mask with a crossed eye and a red beam, five small white skulls floating at the right.
works.reading: The small skulls have hollow eyes and teeth, drawn in black line. The large mask has a pink hand at the eye and a yellow crossed box. The teeth are white dots in a red box. Thin lines of yellow and blue run across. Recorded with 218 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #27
works.text: A mask with a red crossed eye and a spiral eye, a grin of white teeth, and two red hands raised at the bottom corners, on dark blue.
works.caption: A mask with a red crossed eye and a spiral eye, grinning, two red hands raised below.
works.reading: The hands are red with the fingers spread, at both lower corners. The crossed eye is a red ring with a pink X. The spiral eye is green. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth. Recorded with 140 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #30
works.text: A dark head lit by beams of gold from the upper right, its face painted in yellow and brown with a grin of teeth, two hands raised, and a row of gold bars at the lower left like coins. Pink and green dashes float in the dark. The light is the subject: it falls across the head and the hands and leaves everything else black. With 517 recorded strokes it is the most worked mask in the room.
works.caption: A dark head lit by beams of gold from the upper right, hands raised, gold coins below.
works.reading: The beams are soft bands of gold and pale yellow. The head is painted in yellow with brown shadow and a grin of white teeth. The hands are drawn in gold line. The bars at the lower left are stacked gold ovals.

chapters.title: Spring 2024
chapters.opening: February to May 2024. Seven last masks: a framed crown, a skull on red, glasses on green, goggles on blue, curly hair, a man with a beam, and a hatted scream.

works.title: nnxyz #31
works.text: A crowned yellow mask in a black frame with green spikes, two spiral eyes, a grin of white zigzag teeth, and two small black figures at the lower corners.
works.caption: A crowned yellow mask in a black frame with green spikes, two spiral eyes, white zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The crown is a row of black points along the top. The spirals are drawn in white and black. The teeth are white zigzag in a dark mouth. The small figures at the corners are black with white faces. Recorded with 219 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #32
works.text: A skull mask on red drawn in thick white line, with a ringed eye, a crown of purple spikes, a mouth of white loops, and a yellow bar across the top.
works.caption: A skull mask on red in thick white line, a crown of purple spikes, white loops for teeth.
works.reading: The white line is thick and loose, drawn in one or two loops around the head. The ringed eye at the left is white spirals. The teeth are a row of white loops. Two bones cross at the lower left. Eighty-one strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #36
works.text: A mask in square glasses on green, a yellow beam crossing behind the lenses, a grin of white teeth, two hands raised, drawn in black and orange scribble.
works.caption: A mask in square glasses on green, a yellow beam behind the lenses, a grin of white teeth, hands raised.
works.reading: The glasses are two dark boxes with white inside. The beam is a yellow band at eye height. The teeth are white blocks in a wide mouth. The hands are drawn in orange scribble at the lower corners. Recorded with 160 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #37
works.text: A blue skull mask in goggles with a crossed eye between the lenses, a yellow beam, a grille of white teeth, and a crown of black spikes, on blue.
works.caption: A blue skull mask in goggles, a crossed eye between the lenses, a yellow beam, white teeth.
works.reading: The goggles are two blue boxes with white rings inside. The crossed eye at the center is a red and yellow target. The beam is a yellow bar from the top. The teeth are white bars in a black mouth. Sixty-nine strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #41
works.text: An orange mask with curly yellow hair, a flower for one eye and a black spiral for the other, a grille of white teeth, drawn in white and black line.
works.caption: An orange mask with curly yellow hair, a flower for one eye, a black spiral for the other, white teeth.
works.reading: The hair is a mass of yellow loops across the top. The flower eye is orange petals around a red spiral. The spiral eye is black and white. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth. Eighty-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #43
works.text: A man in glasses with spiky yellow hair on red, drawn in dark scribble with pink and blue inside, a yellow beam shooting from his glasses to the upper right, one hand raised. The face is more a person than a mask: a nose, a mouth, glasses that sit on the nose. Ten months after the first numbered head in glasses, the glasses are back, and the beam that crossed behind them now leaves from them.
works.caption: A man in glasses with spiky yellow hair on red, a yellow beam shooting from his glasses, one hand raised.
works.reading: The hair is yellow and black strokes standing up. The glasses are black frames with white lenses. The beam is a yellow bar with a dark edge. The hand at the left is drawn in white and black line. Recorded with 228 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #48
works.text: A head in a brown hat screams on teal, its mouth wide open on white teeth, its eyes shut, its hands at its ears, painted in olive and gold with scribble over it. The hat is drawn in dark brown with a wide brim. The mouth is the largest in the room. It is the last numbered mask, drawn May 30, 2024.
works.caption: A head in a brown hat screams on teal, mouth wide open, eyes shut, hands at its ears.
works.reading: The eyes are two closed curves under the brim. The mouth is a dark oval with a row of white teeth at the top and bottom. The hands are drawn in yellow and black line at both sides. The ground is teal with lighter blue scribble. Recorded with 167 strokes.

closing: Look again at the first head in glasses, grinning on white, and then at the last, screaming in a hat on teal. Both are heads with their mouths open. One is a mask with the scribble on top. The other is a face, painted, with its eyes shut.
